name: page-model-card-parity
goal: Page Models use unchanged catalog cards and exclude type collections at every revision

evidence: 428eac5a6 introduced context-specific footer suppression. Existing registry category also treats .types collections as models, exposed by new transitive page dependencies. Preserve source names and categorize type collections separately.

Existing category and Page Models tests accepted kind=model alone and checked only model link text. Extend the normal shared fixture with paired Order and Order.types, compare complete catalog/relationship cards, and exercise footer previews at current/historical revisions and all viewports.

c98931909 committed tests fail in a clean installed snapshot on both classification and full card equality; all three browser viewports also fail on the missing Used In footer. Before captures inspected.

Restore the canonical catalog card without context overrides. Apply the existing model-versus-type-collection naming contract in the shared classifier. Extend standardized category/card acceptance matrices with paired sources and complete card equality.

Removed showUsage from the shared API and Page Models caller. Type collections become uncategorized Type definitions while real model sources retain identity. Standard tests now compare full catalog cards and reject sibling type collections at current and historical revisions.
